model_identity.name: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Q4_K_M
model_identity.sha256_source: Reused verbatim from experiments/R2-11-predictive-retention/acquisition_plan.json.model_identity -- same canonical model used continuously since R2-08/R2-09A/R2-BRIDGE-01/R2-11. A different model would require a new R2-12 protocol version (section 8).

fixed_identity_known_at_phase0.note: Reused verbatim from R2-11; these are the only hardware/software identity fields already fixed at Phase-0 freeze time, since no runtime execution has occurred to probe live machine telemetry.

fields_to_be_captured_and_stamped_at_fir.method: At the FIRST real pre-run-gate pass on the real host (the transition to R2_12_RUNTIME_READY, not performed in this Phase-0 freeze), the pre-run gate (see execution_plan.json) reads these fields from the live host and writes them into an additive HARDWARE-IDENTITY-STAMP.json record. That record becomes the frozen target hardware identity for the remainder of the campaign.

no_silent_hardware_change_rule: Every subsequent run's pre-run gate re-reads cpu_model, physical_ram_bytes, gpu_or_igpu, storage_device_hosting_expert_store, os_version, and the two binary hashes, and compares them against HARDWARE-IDENTITY-STAMP.json. ANY mismatch fails the pre-run gate closed (abort that run, do not silently proceed). power_mode is checked against machine_state_contract.json's fixed_power_mode requirement, not against the stamp (it is a per-run control, not an identity field, but must still be fixed throughout).
